title: Funeral Attendants
description: Perform a variety of tasks during funeral, such as placing casket in parlor or chapel prior to service, arranging floral offerings or lights around casket, directing or escorting mourners, closing casket, and issuing and storing funeral equipment.

tasks.text: Greet people at the funeral home.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Physical presence greeting customers

tasks.text: Perform a variety of tasks during funerals to assist funeral directors and to ensure that services run smoothly and as planned.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — AI analyzes operations to flag efficiency gains

dwas.name: Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency.

tasks.text: Close caskets at appropriate point in services.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of caskets with care

tasks.text: Direct or escort mourners to parlors or chapels in which wakes or funerals are being held.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — In-person directions need situated human presence

dwas.name: Provide patrons with directions to locales or attractions.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with People Outside the Organization

tasks.text: Place caskets in parlors or chapels prior to wakes or funerals.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of caskets with care

tasks.text: Offer assistance to mourners as they enter or exit limousines.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically assisting boarding and exiting

dwas.name: Assist patrons with entering or exiting vehicles or other forms of transportation.

tasks.text: Clean funeral parlors or chapels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical cleaning of facilities and work areas

tasks.text: Arrange floral offerings or lights around caskets.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Arranging items is physical placement

dwas.name: Arrange items for use or display.

tasks.text: Clean and drive funeral vehicles, such as cars or hearses, in funeral processions.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Tool cleaning is physical manipulation

dwas.name: Drive vehicles to transport patrons.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Act as pallbearers.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical handling of caskets with care

tasks.text: Supervise funeral processions and assist with cemetery parking.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Mortuary direction is hands-on and emotionally situated

tasks.text: Deliver floral arrangements or other items to family members of the deceased.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical delivery of items in real environments

tasks.text: Carry flowers to hearses or limousines for transportation to places of interment.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Physical delivery of items in real environments

tasks.text: Perform general maintenance tasks for funeral homes, such as maintaining equipment or caring for funeral grounds.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Facility upkeep is hands-on physical work

tasks.text: Issue and store funeral equipment.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Scheduling/allocation logic helps; human resolves conflicts

dwas.name: Assign resources or facilities to patrons or employees.

tasks.text: Provide advice to mourners on how to make charitable donations in honor of the deceased.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Comfort and encouragement need live emotional presence

dwas.name: Provide counsel, comfort, or encouragement to individuals or families.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Embalm, dress, cosmeticize, and casket the deceased.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Makeup application requires fine manual dexterity

dwas.name: Apply makeup to alter or enhance appearance.

tasks.text: Prepare obituaries for newspapers.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Write informational material from brief

tasks.text: Obtain burial permits and register deaths.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Administrative documents drafted from templates

tasks.text: Transport the deceased to the funeral home.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical transport of biological materials

dwas.name: Transport biological or other medical materials.

tasks.text: Obtain doctors' signatures on death certificate and complete other paperwork, such as insurance claims forms.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Broad clerical tasks partly automatable, human oversees exceptions

tasks.text: Assist with cremations and the processing and packaging of cremated remains.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on loading of processing equipment

dwas.name: Load materials into equipment for processing.
Load items into ovens or furnaces.

tasks.text: Attend to the needs of the bereaved, such as by offering comfort, counseling, or after-care programs.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Comfort and encouragement need live emotional presence

dwas.name: Provide counsel, comfort, or encouragement to individuals or families.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Perform various administrative tasks, such as typing documents or answering telephone calls.
